13
APPENDIX A
 
/ EXPLANATIONS

General

NAV

Net Asset Value of all securities, cash, and expected dividend payouts (dividend

entitlements) as of a particular day. Securities and cash are valued using closing prices

from the previous trading day.

Deposits

Money that you have transferred into your StashAway account.

The recorded date of deposit is the date when all transfer-related assessments

(
such as anti-money laundering checks) have been performed successfully

and the deposited amount has been allocated into your portfolio(s).

Withdrawals

Money that you have withdrawn from your StashAway account.

The recorded date of the withdrawal will be the date when the transfer to your

bank account

has been initiated from our side.

Account Summary and Portfolio Summary

Opening Balance

NAV of your account and NAV of your portfolios as of the first day of the statement month.

Cashflow

The sum of all deposits minus the sum of all withdrawals within the statement month.

Total Returns

Sum of returns that the securities (ETFs) in your portfolios have generated, including

paid-out dividends and expected dividend payouts.

Fees

Amount charged by StashAway for the provision of our services for the month preceding

the statement month. Note that ETF management fees are not part of this fee, as they

are implicitly charged by the ETF provider and factored into the NAV.
 
Similarly, currency

conversion fees will be reflected inside the NAV already.

Closing Balance

NAV of your account and NAV of your portfolios as of the last day of the statement month.

Portfolio Details

Opening Balance

Value of each security as of the first day of the statement month, using the preceding

trading day's closing prices.

Bought

Amount spent on buy-orders of this security within the statement month, including

potential re-invested dividends.

Sold

Amount received from sell-orders of this security within the statement month.

Dividends

Total dividends paid out by the security (ETF) within the statement month. Part of these

dividends may have been re-invested within the same month already.

Rebates

For StashAway Simple™
 
and Simple Plus funds, we receive a rebate from the Unit Trust

manager on a quarterly basis. We return these rebates back to you on a quarterly basis,

and this rebate will be reflected in the monthly statements for the month following

a quarter-end (April for Q1, July for Q2, October for Q3, and January for Q4). Rebate

payments are calculated based on the units that you have held in the underlying fund

for each day of the quarter.

Closing Balance

Value of each security as of the last day of the statement month, using the preceding

month's final trading day's closing prices.

Profit/Loss %

The closing balance plus dividends divided by the opening balance plus net cash flows for

a given security.

Total Outstanding Units

Total units owned for a given security.

(as the case may be) is not available at the time of printing of the statement of account, StashAway will report to you the applicable exchange rates, NAV, values of
securities bought and sold, and dividends based on the last available information provided to StashAway by Saxo or the Intermediary. In such a case, StashAway
will inform you accordingly. StashAway does not assume responsibility for the accuracy, timeliness and completeness of the information as reported by Saxo, the
Intermediary and StashAway will not accept liability for any loss arising from your use of, or reliance on, such information.
Subject to the above paragraph, the net asset value, or NAV of each security for any particular day is valued using the closing prices of the relevant exchange where
the security is listed from the previous trading day. For example, the prices of the security indicated in the Opening Balance of the Portfolio Balance is calculated
based on the closing prices of the relevant exchange where the security is listed from the trading day before the first day of the statement month. The information
stated in the statement of account are reported to you in the reporting currency indicated in the statement rounded to the nearest two decimal places, and where
applicable, based on the stated exchange rate which is based on the closing exchange rate of the trading day before the day of the Opening or Closing balance, as
applicable.
